sql: SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id, event_id, label FROM events ORDER BY customer_id, tick DESC NULLS LAST, event_id DESC

WITH chosen AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id,event_id,label FROM events WHERE customer_id >= $1 ORDER BY customer_id,tick DESC NULLS LAST,event_id DESC) SELECT customer_id,event_id,concat(label,$2,' literal $1') AS name FROM chosen WHERE customer_id <= $3 ORDER BY customer_id
SELECT event_id,active IS DISTINCT FROM $1 AS changed FROM events WHERE customer_id >= $2 ORDER BY event_id
SELECT event_id,concat('name=',label,';') AS caption FROM events ORDER BY tick DESC NULLS LAST,event_id
SELECT DISTINCT ON (customer_id) customer_id,label FROM events ORDER BY customer_id,tick DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT event_id FROM events WHERE label ~ '^[a-z]+$'
